name: LinkedIn Jobs
reason: No automated scraping/login. Use official job alerts as a complement.

name: Indeed
reason: Not scraped by this project; prefer employer ATS/career pages and permitted public feeds.

name: EURES
reason: Official EU/EEA/Swiss source, updated daily; no stable unauthenticated public vacancy API is assumed by this package.

name: Welcome to the Jungle
reason: Useful European portal, but no unauthenticated public feed is relied upon here.

name: eFinancialCareers
reason: High-signal finance/compliance portal; this project does not rely on unauthenticated scraping of it.
